metaTitle: Custom Recycled Cotton Tote Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled cotton tote bags in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly, durable, and perfect for your brand. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Recycled cotton tote bags offer the same soft, natural feel as conventional cotton but with a fraction of the environmental impact. Made from post-industrial or post-consumer waste, these bags are a concrete way to show your commitment to sustainability. Whether you're outfitting a trade show team or creating retail giveaways, recycled cotton totes hold up to daily use and accept screen printing or embroidery cleanly. They're a practical choice for brands that want their logo on something that genuinely matters.
heroAltText: Custom recycled cotton tote bags with screen-printed logo, eco-friendly and durable for bulk orders
